final_message:
Configured pc1 as the lab’s DNS server with the requested host records and MX records for all four mail domains. All 20 PCs and four routers now point to pc1 for DNS; the existing connections and routes are unchanged.

The startup scripts passed shell syntax checks. I couldn’t run the lab or verify DNS queries because Kathara isn’t available and access to Docker is denied in this environment. The configuration also depends on BIND’s `named` being available in the `kathara/base` image. DNS mail discovery is configured; this does not set up mail delivery services on pc4–pc7.
